text:
maria: deploybot flagged preflight eval: summarizer prompt suite shows +6.4% hallucination regression vs baseline. Hold release? /cc @aj @sam

deploybot: ```deploybot: preflight-eval FAILED for release v2026.03.20-beta
suite: summarizer
metric: hallucination_rate delta +6.4% (threshold 2.0%)
action: canary hold applied```

aj: yikes. can you attach the failing examples?

deploybot: failing_examples: https://redwood-internal/evals/2790012345  ids: [241, 242, 243]

sam: i'll take a quick look. likely model variant mismatch or tokenization change. @leo can you check quantization/tokenizer flags in this build?

leo: on it. quick diff shows tokenizer config changed: normalize_unicode=true flipped in this PR. that could explain hallucination increase.

sam: if that's the culprit i'd prefer pinning the route to previous build and bisecting. pin -> unblocks release window.

maria: agree. request ops to pin traffic to v2026.03.19-stable for summarizer route. then we'll run a focused eval on the failing prompts.

aj: ops: can you pin? @ops

qa-bot: qa-bot: rerun scheduled eval with seed=42 and 3 repeats. results ETA ~15m

deploybot: deploybot: canary hold persists. to proceed a manual override is required with +approvals from @eng-release and @qa.

leo: i'll open a PR to revert tokenizer change if bisect confirms. ping when rerun done.

sam: :thumbsup: thanks. if rerun looks ok we can unhold and proceed with staged canary.

deploybot: eval rerun complete: hallucination delta +0.3% vs baseline (within threshold). failing examples reclassified as tokenizer-anchored.

maria: great. unhold and pin to previous build for 2 hours while we merge revert PR? Or we can proceed with canary unpinned? prefer unhold + pin short window.

aj: approve unhold and temporary pin for safety. +1 from me.

leo: +1 technical lead. will cut hotfix PR now.

maria: deploybot, apply unhold and set pin=v2026.03.19-stable for route summarizer for 2h. also add release note mention.

deploybot: actioned: canary unhold applied. route pinned to v2026.03.19-stable (2h). releasebot notified.

maria: thanks team. follow up notes: add eval regression test for tokenizer flags to preflight suites.
